note: generalizable. thresholds and verdict logic only - no cohort measurements. a new cohort is evaluated against this same file.

checks.description: known positive markers detected for the tissue/disease
known negative controls absent or near-zero
Moran's I > 0.3 for >= 3 of top 5 positive markers
checks.routes: selects the molecular encoder branch (spatial GNN vs non-spatial)

checks.description: technical silhouette <= biological silhouette, or both <= 0
encoder input format decided; blocking if unresolved

caution_if: spatial_autocorrelation_pass false but Moran's I > caution_floor for most markers
a required check is null rather than measured

learned_checks.note: checks established in practice but never encoded in EDA.md. advisory in contract 1.0 - reported, never verdict-changing.

items.description: every check records which matrix it read
items.rationale: a directory named raw may hold normalized values; filenames are not evidence

items.description: unit count at each stage plus a reason for every drop
items.rationale: aggregate counts cannot be reconciled after the fact

items.description: encoder-specific minimum unit count per sample
items.rationale: below an encoder's prototype count, zero-shot inference is undefined

items.description: NMI(candidate_label, subject_id) before any clustering metric
items.rationale: a subject-level label makes clustering a subject-classification task

items.description: fraction of samples carrying each annotation
items.rationale: determines which hypotheses are answerable at all

items.description: flag any cohort-level statistic computed on one sample
items.rationale: an n=1 measurement should not gate a cohort decision
